nrp-continuity.support: Final historical paragraph before results: intended dissolution in late 2008 failed to unite all religious-Zionist parties; NRP contested 2009 as Jewish Home. Formal registration date remains unverified.

rafi-history.support: History paragraphs: Rafi arose from the 1965 departure from Mapai; most members joined Labor in 1968, while others established successor lists including the State List.

maki-history.support: History paragraphs: Rakah departed in 1965; the residual Maki continued. Rakah later reused the Maki name, and is the principal component of Hadash.

shinui-history.support: History paragraphs: Shinui was founded in 1974, joined Dash in 1976, and re-emerged as a separate parliamentary group when Dash disintegrated. This is not a first foundation in 1978.

tehiya-history.support: History paragraphs: founded in 1979 by departing Likud MKs and other activists.

mada-history.support: History paragraphs: founded in 1988 by Darawshe after leaving Labor.

third-way-history.support: History paragraphs: movement began in 1994, party in early 1996; Kahalani and Zussman subsequently left Labor to join it. Parliamentary split does not date the original movement.

am-ehad-history.support: Opening paragraph: founded in early 1999 by three departing Labor MKs.

kadima-history.support: History paragraphs: Sharon left Likud in November 2005 and established Kadima; Livni departed in 2012.

tami-continuity.support: History and results: one Tami organisation contested in 1981 and 1984.

haolam-continuity.support: History and results: one movement founded in 1965 contested both 1965 and 1969.

yemenite-continuity.support: Opening paragraph: the association contested both the first and second Knesset elections.

sephardi-continuity.support: Opening paragraph and results: the same organisation served in the first and second Knessets.

hadash-continuity.support: History and results: Hadash contested every election since 1977. The profile loosely says merger; the detailed 2023 book p.363 explicitly distinguishes the front from its component party.
